title: Spatiotemporal Imputation with Graph-Informed Flow Matching at ICML 2026
body: Our work on graph-informed flow matching for spatiotemporal imputation was accepted at ICML 2026.

title: Joined Télécom SudParis as Assistant Professor
body: I joined Télécom SudParis, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, as an Assistant Professor.

title: Continuous Simplicial Neural Networks at NeurIPS 2025
body: Our work on continuous neural models for simplicial complexes was accepted at NeurIPS 2025.

title: Subgraph contrastive learning at ECML PKDD 2025
body: Our work on Subgraph Gaussian Embedding Contrast for self-supervised graph representation learning appeared at ECML PKDD 2025.

title: Continuous Product Graph Neural Networks at NeurIPS 2024
body: Our Continuous Product Graph Neural Networks work was accepted at NeurIPS 2024.

title: HI! PARIS postdoctoral fellowship
body: I received a HI! PARIS postdoctoral fellowship supporting my research on graph machine learning.
